REFORM3D

Broken or hard to use doesn’t mean useless.

ReForm3D designs the small 3D-printable part that repairs an object you own, or makes it usable for people with weak grip, low vision or limited mobility. No new product, no landfill.

Explore how it works Repair your object

Team Big Hero 6 · Hack4SDG · Accessibility by design

Scroll to repair

Everyday objects fail millions of people: a small part breaks, or they were never made for every hand.

  • Not broken beyond repair

    Most of these products still work. What failed is one small part: a knob, a clip, a cap.

  • Built for one kind of body

    Jar lids, taps, keys, pens and canes assume strong grip, steady hands, good sight and easy balance. For people with arthritis, tremor, low vision or reduced mobility, they become barriers.

  • Two bad options

    Buy a whole new product or a specialist aid, or hope someone online already designed the exact part you need. Neither is fast, cheap or reliable.

How can generative AI turn a broken or inaccessible object into a personalized, 3D-printable fix instead of forcing replacement?

How it works

ReForm3D is an AI system that looks at an object you already own and generates a small, custom 3D-printable intervention to repair it or make it accessible to the person using it, instead of generating new products from scratch.
